issues.description: The solution's WHERE clause for Aufgabe 05 uses an AND to test the Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk against two different values: AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Oberbayern' AND Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Niederbayern'). The problem statement explicitly asks for Gemeinden in Oberbayern OR Niederbayern. Using AND between two mutually exclusive equality checks makes the condition impossible to satisfy and will produce no rows, contradicting the task requirement and confusing students.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the logical condition to use OR (or IN) so it matches the problem statement. For example: WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Wanderweg_zu_Gemeinde.gemeindeschluessel AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Oberbayern' OR Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Niederbayern')  — or equivalently: AND Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk IN ('Oberbayern','Niederbayern').
